About the Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride group ride

A weekly road ride out of the Freewheel shop near the U of M. About 25 miles at 15–17 mph. Road or gravel bike, helmet and light. Sign the waiver through the Strava club event; weather cancellations post there too. The 2026 series ends September 16.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
